name: Orderitto — flat-fee branded apps + web ordering
what_it_does: Branded iOS/Android/web ordering with 0% order commission; flat plans from $149/mo; loyalty, SEO/AI visibility, multi-location.
how_competitors_use_it: Full first-party ordering OS competing with ChowNow/Owner on keep-every-dollar messaging.
what_we_use_today: Never86 social buy-now + pain shoppers; not a branded native-app builder.
gap: Watch only — app-builder OS is not our lane. Use for competitive framing when operators ask about flat-fee direct ordering.
summary: Flat-fee zero-commission ordering OS. Adjacent KEEP rival; Never86 stays social shoppable.
